title: A Ballot for Tibet
description: Two voters mark ballots during elections for the Tibetan government-in-exile at a polling station. The preliminary round of the 2026 elections for Sikyong, or political leader, and the Tibetan Parliament-in-Exile took place across more than 30 countries, with voting centered in Dharamshala, India.
translated_description: 两名选民在一个投票站为西藏流亡政府选举标记选票。2026年司政（即政治领导人）及西藏流亡议会的初选在30多个国家举行，投票中心设在印度达兰萨拉。
